teach_lines.first_skull: Skulls hurt YOU when the enemy attacks. Clear them or brace with Shields.
teach_lines.first_relic: Relics change every run. Hover any relic to read exactly what it does.
teach_lines.first_shop: The shop sells relics, upgrades and consumables. Rerolling costs coins and gets pricier each time.
teach_lines.first_consumable: Consumables are one-use tools. Click one, click a reel, then confirm.
